200.answer: Message Centre is a voicemail service that allows you to save 25 messages, each up to 5 minutes long. You can access voicemails by calling your mailbox or via MMS, which delivers audio files directly to your phone. Message Centre saves messages for up to 14 days and allows you to create a personalized greeting or use a standard greeting. You can retrieve messages for free from your home phone. The cost for Message Centre is $10 per month.
